title: Deep Rectangular Photography Softbox
description: Original static photography softbox with a genuinely deep tapered hollow rectangular hood, closed inset front diffusion panel, rear lamp-head housing and a fixed U-shaped mounting yoke. The head has a real continuous support path through its pivot, yoke, mast, hub and three grounded feet. Five restrained solid PBR materials and separately named closed editable components; no external source dependencies. Metres, source Z up, front -Y, ground origin (0,0,0), mast axis Y=.19 m. Distinct from the existing thin octagonal reflector. One reusable static prop only; no emitted light, optical or electrical simulation, physical light power, animated tilt or folding, engineering, load-bearing, balance, stability or safety certification.
